changes: Round five: every round-four note answered in its screen; "Still open: you decide" and a note index now sit at the top.

Category colours: dark-mode tones brightened and more saturated (7:1 on the dark card, up from 5:1); Admin → Dizains with Krāsas / Kategorijas / Fonti in the new admin layout. All design work ships with the redesign as one release.

Discovery: no "Atklāt" or "Manas grupas" in the header, "Izveidot grupu" as a quiet +, Grupas / Pasākumi as a real switch with the place beside it, all fifteen categories always listed, sub-category chips, photo on the right of every card (phones too).
Cards in context: Manas grupas as a short feed laid out with three questions; joining from the panel (two options); a click outside closes the panel.

Filters (was Hundreds of groups and events): filter research incl. Meetup, Eventbrite, Airbnb; the filter set; sub-categories as chips vs in the drawer; the place for signed-out visitors; "Citur Latvijā"; events away from the group's city.
Events: one-line rows in two columns, details in the side panel with "Eju" and "Visa informācija" on one line; replaces rows that open in place.
Search: categories from the results become tags in the field; the results page uses the same switch, place and chips.
Group page: pages down the left (a drawer on phones), a page's parts as tabs; no two look-alike menus.
Navigation: admin with the site's own header and bottom bar, sections across the top, parts down the left, drawer on phones; the one navigation rule rewritten.
Removed as stale: the old header with Atklāt / Manas grupas, "… vēl 7" categories, the vertical phone card, rows that open in place, the old navigation rule and the old Still open list.
